words.sense: without a definite shape, organization, or boundaries
misconceptions: Any unclear wording has no structure

words.sense: capable of being understood in two or more ways
misconceptions: Any unorganized project contains two definite interpretations

semantic_axes.description: Lacking a definite shape or organization differs from having two or more plausible meanings.

edges.boundary_rule: amorphous lacks coherent form or boundaries; ambiguous allows more than one plausible interpretation.

misconceptions.M1: Treats every unclear message as formless rather than multiply interpretable
misconceptions.M2: Treats every unstructured plan as having two concrete meanings
misconceptions.M3: Surface style alone decides whether the problem is form or interpretation

chains.frame: Which word best describes Aarav's project outline?

beats.text: Aarav's proposal mixed goals, chores and dates with no sections, priorities or assigned responsibilities.
beats.decisive_clue: proposal had no coherent organizational structure
beats.reason: The problem is how the plan is formed, not competing interpretations of one statement.

beats.text: When asked who would do what first, he could not separate tasks from long-term wishes.
beats.reason: His difficulty shows the plan has not taken a definite form.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive evidence remains unclear task boundaries and sequence.
chains.feedback_deep: Amorphous means lacking a clear shape or coherent structure; ambiguous means open to more than one plausible interpretation. The problem is how the plan is formed, not competing interpretations of one statement. His difficulty shows the plan has not taken a definite form.
chains.contrast_rule: amorphous lacks coherent form or boundaries; ambiguous allows more than one plausible interpretation.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Chen's sculpture so far?

beats.text: Chen's clay sat in a spreading lump with no recognizable outline, edges or intended figure.
beats.decisive_clue: clay had no recognizable physical form
beats.reason: The sculpture itself lacks a defined shape.

beats.text: Chen pressed a shallow groove into the lump, but it still had no recognizable outline or intended figure.
beats.decisive_clue: the clay still lacked a recognizable shape after minor shaping
beats.reason: A small surface mark does not give the sculpture a definite form.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Ethan's new club?

beats.text: Ethan's group had no membership rules, organizer or clear activities; nobody knew where one responsibility ended and another began.
beats.decisive_clue: group had no settled boundaries or organization
beats.reason: The trouble is lack of form rather than two rival readings of a statement.

beats.text: Members agreed on the club's name, but that did not establish roles or an activity plan.
beats.decisive_clue: a name did not supply missing structure
beats.reason: A single defined label cannot organize a still-formless group.
